"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The last Farm Bill took far too long to enact due to a lack of leadership from the current Administration and congressional Democrats, creating instability about farm policy for nearly two years.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans are dedicated to leading the country forward, which includes getting things done on time, including the next Farm Bill.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats play politics with farm security.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Much of the Democrats' delay concerning the Farm Bill had to do with their efforts to expand welfare through the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP).",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) comprises more than 70 percent of all farm bill spending.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"During the last eight years of a Democratic Administration, nearly all the work requirements for able-bodied adults, instituted by a 1996 welfare reform, have been removed.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for restoring work requirements for able-bodied adults.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for separating the administration of SNAP from the Department of Agriculture to correct a mistake made when the Food Stamp program was first created in 1964.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
